india_context.procedural_notes: Under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act 1872, any agreement restraining anyone from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void to that extent. Post-employment non-compete clauses in NDAs are strictly unenforceable in India (Percept D'Mark v. Zaheer Khan).
india_context.transitional_notes: Transitional provisions between legacy non-disclosure and incoming DPDP Act 2023 require clear data consent boundaries.
verification_requirements: Verify stamp duty payment under relevant State Stamp Act.
Verify non-solicit duration does not exceed reasonable boundaries.
